title: Step 3: Visualizing Kernel SVM - Non-Linear Classification in Machine Learning

cues.en: Instructor: But now the most exciting part is coming because we're gonna be visualizing the training set results.
cues.zh: 現在最精彩的部分來了，要把訓練集結果視覺化。

cues.en: And actually right now we don't have to change anything except maybe the title here, classifier.
cues.zh: 其實現在什麼都不用改，頂多改這裡的分類器標題。

cues.en: And then here you need to specify Kernel SVM, Kernel SVM as well as here in the test set.
cues.zh: 這裡指定 Kernel SVM，測試集這裡也一樣。

cues.en: So here, Kernel SVM as well.
cues.zh: 這裡也改成 Kernel SVM。

cues.en: All right, now we can get some coffee and just execute this and watch the results.
cues.zh: 好，現在可以拿杯咖啡，直接執行並看結果。

cues.en: So we're gonna do this.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: We're going to first look at the results here and press command controls enter to execute.
cues.zh: 先看這裡的結果，按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: And wow, these are the beautiful results of Kernel SVM.
cues.zh: 哇，這就是核心 SVM 漂亮的結果。

cues.en: We can see how it's making this curve here to classify well most of the users in the social network here since we have a two dimensional space here from datasets that means that the dataset was mapped
cues.zh: 可以看到它在這裡彎曲，正確分類社群網路中的多數使用者。這裡的資料是二維空間，代表資料集映射到了

cues.en: to a 3D dimensional space.
cues.zh: 三維空間。

cues.en: And then on this dimensional space it managed to make the data linearly separable so that it can find a linear hyperplane that separates in a much better way than two classes.
cues.zh: 在那個空間中，它讓資料變得線性可分，就能找出更好地分開兩個類別的線性超平面。

cues.en: And then it projected back to this two dimensional space to finally obtain this curve here that separates in a much better way the two classes
cues.zh: 接著再投影回二維空間，最後得到這條曲線，它分開兩個類別的表現，

cues.en: than a linear classifier would do with a straight line here, as we saw for logistic regression or SVM, SVM with the linear Kernel.
cues.zh: 遠比線性分類器用直線好，就像先前的邏輯斯迴歸，或使用線性核心的 SVM。

cues.en: So that's what happened.
cues.zh: 發生的就是這些。

cues.en: That's what happened behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 這就是背後的過程。

cues.en: The Kernel SVM did an amazing job.
cues.zh: 核心 SVM 做得非常好。

cues.en: So we can say congrats.
cues.zh: 可以說聲恭喜。

cues.en: Okay, so for those of you who are seeing this for the first time, I'll just quickly remind what it is.
cues.zh: 好，如果你第一次看到這個，快速提醒一下它是什麼。

cues.en: The points here are the true observations, the true results.
cues.zh: 這些點是真實觀測值、真實結果。

cues.en: So the red points are the users who didn't buy the SUV in reality.
cues.zh: 紅點代表實際沒有購買 SUV 的使用者。

cues.en: And the green points are the users who bought the SUV.
cues.zh: 綠點代表購買 SUV 的使用者。

cues.en: And then the regions that we see here are the prediction regions.
cues.zh: 這裡看到的區域則是預測區域。

cues.en: So the red region is the region where our model predicts that the user doesn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 紅色區域是模型預測使用者不會購買 SUV 的區域。

cues.en: And the green region is the one where our model predicts that the user buys the SUV.
cues.zh: 綠色區域則是模型預測使用者會購買 SUV 的區域。

cues.en: So for example, that means that for this particular user red points, which is in the green region that makes an incorrect prediction because the truth is the user didn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 例如，這位特定使用者是落在綠色區域的紅點，代表錯誤預測，因為真實情況是他沒有購買 SUV。

cues.en: But since this user is in the green region, that means that the model predicted that this user bought the SUV, even if that's not what happened in real life.
cues.zh: 但他在綠色區域，代表模型預測他購買了 SUV，即使現實並非如此。

cues.en: So that's where the graph is about.
cues.zh: 這就是圖表表達的內容。

cues.en: And here is the non-linear separator of the Kernel SVM algorithm.
cues.zh: 這裡是核心 SVM 演算法的非線性分隔線。

cues.en: And thanks to this nonlinear separator, our Kernel SVM could classify correctly those users here which wasn't the case for the linear separators because since we had the straight lines,
cues.zh: 透過這條非線性分隔線，核心 SVM 能正確分類這些使用者，線性分隔線做不到，因為先前是直線，

cues.en: it couldn't catch these users in the right category.
cues.zh: 無法把這些使用者涵蓋在正確類別。

cues.en: That is the green category, because those users actually bought the SUV in real life.
cues.zh: 也就是綠色類別，因為這些使用者實際上購買了 SUV。

cues.en: So they should be in the green region.
cues.zh: 所以他們應該在綠色區域。

cues.en: And this wasn't the case for the linear separator.
cues.zh: 線性分隔線做不到。

cues.en: And now it's the case for the Kernel SVM separator because it's a non-linear classifier.
cues.zh: 現在核心 SVM 的分隔線可以，因為它是非線性分類器。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now let's have a look at the test set results to see how our model behaves on new observations to see if it can still classify and predict the results of new observations.
cues.zh: 現在看測試集結果，看看模型對新觀測值的表現，是否仍能正確分類、預測新觀測值。

cues.en: So we're gonna do this.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: We only have to select this press command controls enter to execute
cues.zh: 只要選取這段，按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行，

cues.en: and here are the test set results.
cues.zh: 這就是測試集結果。

cues.en: Okay, so that looks great as well.
cues.zh: 好，看起來也很棒。

cues.en: First, an important thing to understand is that the regions that we see here are the same regions as we saw in the dataset.
cues.zh: 首先要理解，這裡看到的區域與先前資料中的區域相同。

cues.en: If you go back to the training set and then go back to the test set you can see that the regions here don't change.
cues.zh: 如果回到訓練集，再回到測試集，可以看到這裡的區域不會改變。

cues.en: Only the observation points change because of course these are new observation points.
cues.zh: 只有觀測點改變，因為當然是新的觀測點。

cues.en: And so here we can see that the Kernel SVM did an amazing job at classifying new observations because all these tests set observations here are the users who didn't buy the SUV
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，核心 SVM 分類新觀測值的表現很好，因為這些測試集觀測值全都是沒有購買 SUV 的使用者，

cues.en: because the points are red and they are in the red region.
cues.zh: 點是紅色，而且位在紅色區域。

cues.en: That is the region where our classifier predicts that the users don't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 也就是分類器預測使用者不會購買 SUV 的區域。

cues.en: So that's correct predictions.
cues.zh: 所以是正確預測。

cues.en: Same for these guys here.
cues.zh: 這些也一樣。

cues.en: All the green points that fall in the green region.
cues.zh: 所有落在綠色區域的綠點。

cues.en: And of course we have those incorrect predictions which are, for example, this green user here who is in the red region, as well as those two green here.
cues.zh: 當然也有錯誤預測，例如這位落在紅色區域的綠色使用者，以及這兩個綠點。

cues.en: So that three.
cues.zh: 所以是三個。

cues.en: Then we have the red users, this one, this one.
cues.zh: 接著紅色使用者，這個、這個。

cues.en: So 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and actually 10.
cues.zh: 所以四、五、六、七、八、九，實際上是十個。

cues.en: We can see that there is a little green point here hiding behind the red points.
cues.zh: 可以看到一個小綠點躲在紅點後面。

cues.en: Okay, yeah, so that's definitely a very good job.
cues.zh: 好，這確實表現非常好。

cues.en: You will see how the next classifiers will make a different style of classification of separation.
cues.zh: 接下來的分類器會用不同的分類、分隔方式。

cues.en: You will see that it won't be a curve it will be something else.
cues.zh: 你會看到不是曲線，而是其他形狀。

cues.en: And I will let you find out about the surprise.
cues.zh: 就讓你自己發現這個驚喜。

cues.en: But definitely the Kernel SVM is a great classifier when your data is not linearly separable.
cues.zh: 但資料不是線性可分時，核心 SVM 絕對是很棒的分類器。

cues.en: And we can see how it definitely improved the results of the linear classifiers that we saw with the logistic regression and SVM.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它確實改善了先前邏輯斯迴歸與 SVM 這些線性分類器的結果。

cues.en: All right, so thank you for watching this tutorial about Kernel SVM I hope you enjoyed it.
cues.zh: 好，感謝收看這堂核心 SVM 教學，希望你喜歡。

cues.en: There will be a few more surprises with the next classifiers as I told you.
cues.zh: 就像說過的，接下來的分類器還會有更多驚喜。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
